issue.title: Tasks JS sandbox init hits the 2s expression deadline on busy hosts, failing queries with no by-function
issue.description:
Found by the bob-cli-31 (task freshness) land agent while verifying `bob freshness list` on apollo. This is pre-existing code (js.rs EXPRESSION_TIMEOUT dates from bob-cli-9.5/9.6, July 2026), not caused by bob-cli-31; the new freshness command simply exposed it.

Expected fix scope: src/native/dataview/tasks/{js.rs,mod.rs}. Only build JsSandbox when a by-function filter, sort or group needs it, or arm a separate, larger deadline for the initialization/hydration unit. Add a regression test: a query without by-function must not depend on sandbox initialization time (for example, inject a tiny init budget or count sandbox constructions).

task_type_fields.impact: Any command that runs a native Tasks query (bob query, bob plan, bob freshness list/seed, task-status-hooks plan budgets, the tmux plan segment) can fail intermittently with a JavaScript "interrupted" error on a busy machine. The failure looks like a bad query rather than a timeout, and agents hit it while builds or tests are running. Suggested fix: create the sandbox lazily, only when the parsed query uses a by-function clause, and/or give initialization its own budget that scales with task count, separate from the 2 s per-expression budget.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/dataview/tasks/js.rs:30 (EXPRESSION_TIMEOUT) and JsSandbox::new; eager creation in src/native/dataview/tasks/mod.rs (query_matching_descriptions, query_rich_tasks, run, run_note)
task_type_fields.repro:
On a loaded host (load average ~22 during a cargo test run), run against the live vault:

    for i in 1 2 3; do bob freshness list -f json | head -c 200; echo; done

One run in three failed after 2.6 s with exit 1:

    {"error":"JavaScript error while initializing the Tasks JavaScript sandbox: Error: interrupted\n    at Tt (eval_script:5:20051) ... at __bobMoment (eval_script:15:12)\n    at TasksDate (eval_script:33:22)\n    at __bobHydrateTask (eval_script:84:47)\n    at map (native)\n","ok":false,"schema_version":1}

The next two runs succeeded (about 4-5 s each). Once the load dropped, `bob plan -f json` and `bob freshness list` passed 4/4 and 3/3.

Root cause: src/native/dataview/tasks/js.rs sets EXPRESSION_TIMEOUT = 2 s and arms it per eval unit. JsSandbox::new evaluates one initialization unit that JSON-parses and hydrates every task in the vault through Moment (`__bobTasks.map(__bobHydrateTask)`). Every native Tasks query path creates that sandbox eagerly, even when the query has no `by function` clause: query_matching_descriptions (bob plan lanes and plan budgets), query_rich_tasks (bob freshness), run (bob query) and run_note, all in src/native/dataview/tasks/mod.rs. So whole-vault hydration has to finish inside the 2 s budget meant for one user expression, and it fails on large vaults or busy hosts.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-31 land agent saw bob freshness list fail intermittently with 'interrupted' under load; the sandbox is built eagerly for every Tasks query, so whole-vault hydration must fit a 2s per-expression budget.

evidence.note: Proposed by bob-cli-55.1 note #3; independent landing reproduction on master 092e098: cargo run --quiet -- freshness list -f json exits 1 with schema_version 10, ok false, and JavaScript error while initializing the Tasks JavaScript sandbox: Error: interrupted, including __bobMoment/TasksDate/__bobHydrateTask. All 111 freshness lib tests and 43 freshness CLI tests pass on fixture vaults. The eager whole-vault sandbox initialization deadline is pre-existing and not changed by the Tickler rename. No duplicate task.

payload.entry: Lazy JsSandbox + separate init budget verified on athena (uncommitted tree on efd6074): base binary fails 'bob query --tasks not done -f json' on live ~/bob vault under load with 'JavaScript error while initializing the Tasks JavaScript sandbox: Error: interrupted'; fixed tree returns exit 0 with 494 tasks under load ~80 and a by-function query returns 122 tasks. lib 1905 pass; tasks/dataview/parity suites pass; new regression tests: uses_javascript incl. all four lane queries, None-sandbox filter/build paths, init_timeout scaling/cap, fixture-vault no-sandbox query.
